statement: Independently reproduce the bounded Call Cell lagrange.partial.v1 finite-JSON value representation using a source-free Python-stdlib encoder/decoder, canonical positive and rejected-wire vectors, inverse mutation controls and a focused source-path witness. This Q1b scope is the value-only encoding, parsing, Unicode, numeric and default limit contract; it excludes versioned partial envelopes, semantic group-key transport, schema matching, HLC, Raft, mixed-node/on-disk behavior and public-service certification.

constraints.statement: The existing Call Cell canonical-partial codec and service reference own value semantics. This Quest adds only language-neutral documentation, vectors and independent proof; it creates no alternate runtime codec or owner.

No src changes, public transport/wire envelope or group-key equivalence, cross-version or same-disk compatibility, HLC representation, Raft arithmetic, guest runtime replacement, cutover-gate expansion, legacy path or fallback.

The reference must compute outputs from inputs, not echo expected vectors; negative control mutations must turn the checker red, novel Python-only values must exercise the same grammar, and the real source codec is exercised separately through its focused test.
